name: Rongxue
source: By chance, you meet the hostess of the "Yusetsu" bar, Fengxiang and she brings you there. Here you can drink and chat with girls and as their friendliness improves, they will slowly open up to you.
translation: By chance, you meet the hostess of the "Yusetsu" bar, Fengxiang and she brings you there. Here you can drink and chat with girls and as their friendliness improves, they will slowly open up to you.
